author: Medicines Optimisation / Clinical Genomics joint rule set
source: CPIC codeine/CYP2D6 guideline; MHRA codeine safety advice

ultrarapid_metaboliser.summary: CYP2D6 ultrarapid metaboliser: codeine produces excessive morphine and risks life-threatening respiratory depression. Avoid. Use a non-CYP2D6 analgesic.

alternatives.label: Paracetamol +/- NSAID, or morphine if opioid required

poor_metaboliser.summary: CYP2D6 poor metaboliser: codeine gives little or no analgesia. Use a non-CYP2D6 analgesic.

alternatives.label: Paracetamol +/- NSAID, or morphine if opioid required

intermediate_metaboliser.summary: CYP2D6 intermediate metaboliser: codeine analgesia may be reduced. Monitor response and consider an alternative if ineffective.

normal_metaboliser.summary: CYP2D6 normal metaboliser: standard codeine dosing.
